description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Management Specialist – Data Engineer based in the United States. 

 We are seeking an experienced Data Management Specialist – Data Engineer to support critical federal defense initiatives through advanced data engineering, integration, and governance solutions. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines that transform complex data into reliable, actionable insights. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to improve data quality, accessibility, and consistency across multiple enterprise systems. The position involves managing structured and unstructured data, optimizing ETL/ELT processes, and implementing robust metadata and data governance practices. You will also contribute to the development of unified data environments that support mission-critical decision-making. This is an opportunity to apply your technical expertise in a collaborative, mission-driven environment while helping modernize enterprise data capabilities.

Accountabilities:
 

 Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to support analytics and business intelligence across operational systems.

 Develop and maintain data models for operational and analytical environments, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and reusability.

 Implement best practices for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and retrieval across multiple environments.

 Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to define data requirements and deliver reliable, business-focused data solutions.

 Establish and maintain data quality, consistency, and governance through monitoring, testing, validation, and continuous improvement frameworks.

 Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and scripts to support efficient data processing and retrieval.

 Integrate structured and unstructured data from multiple sources, including databases, APIs, streaming platforms, and third-party data feeds.

 Optimize large-scale data processing and performance using distributed computing technologies such as Apache Spark.

 Apply appropriate security, privacy, and compliance standards to all data engineering and management solutions.

 Normalize data elements across systems, build data indexes, implement deduplication logic, investigate discrepancies, and reconcile metadata to establish unified business data views.

 Troubleshoot data-related issues and ensure the reliability, availability, and continuity of data products.

 Define and implement Data Quality (DQ) metrics and improvement measures in accordance with established requirements for Silver and Gold data zones.

 Manage data cataloging, discoverability, metadata, and business rules using enterprise governance platforms such as Collibra.

 Coordinate with multiple business domains, including Acquisition, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance, to improve data integration and connectivity across mission-critical systems.

 Support automated data cataloging and the integration of data dictionaries and metadata, ensuring data descriptions and business rules are accessible and facilitate effective data integration.


 Requirements:


 Active SECRET security clearance is required. An Interim SECRET clearance is also acceptable.

 Bachelor's degree (Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts) from an accredited college or university; a degree in a scientific or technical discipline is preferred.

 At least 5 years of experience supporting federal government clients in the implementation and management of enterprise data management practices.

 Demonstrated experience with Python programming and data engineering solutions.

 Experience working with enterprise data platforms and tools such as Databricks, Databricks SQL Editor, and Erwin Data Modeler.

 Up-to-date knowledge of Collibra Data Governance Center functionalities, including data cataloging, metadata management, and governance capabilities.

 Strong understanding of data engineering principles, including data modeling, pipeline development, ETL/ELT processes, data integration, and data quality management.

 Experience working with structured and unstructured datasets, data normalization, deduplication, metadata reconciliation, and data validation.

 Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks, particularly Apache Spark, is an advantage.

 Understanding of the Department of Defense Procurement Lifecycle, including the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, is beneficial.

 Strong communication, writing, and analytical skills, with the ability to translate technical requirements into effective data solutions.

 Ability to establish collaborative and constructive working relationships, resolve conflicts, negotiate effectively, and demonstrate cultural awareness.

 Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with a results-oriented mindset and the ability to prioritize competing demands and drive tasks through completion.

 Ability to work independently and effectively using Microsoft 365, while contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.


 Benefits:


 Competitive salary and comprehensive total rewards package.

 Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage.

 Life insurance and short- and long-term disability benefits.

 Voluntary supplemental benefits, including critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident coverage.

 Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).

 Retirement savings plan with a 401(k) option.

 Paid leave programs for eligible full-time employees working at least 30 hours per week on a regular basis.

 Flexible work-life balance and remote working environment.

 Professional development and career growth opportunities.

 Performance-based recognition programs.

 Collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

 Comprehensive health and welfare benefits designed to support employees and their families.
